question: Why did the p95 latency go up on 06 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: Request volume increase due to a campaign
why_chain: The request volume for service search increased by 22%.
This increase in requests put additional strain on the connection pool.
The strain on the connection pool led to connection pool exhaustion and increased latency.

ruled_out.reason: No new release or version change is indicated by the evidence.
No specific configuration change is indicated by the evidence.
No evidence points to an infrastructure issue, such as network or server capacity problems.
No evidence points to bad or unusual input data.
The evidence does not clearly point to a specific unknown issue.

evidence.summary: P95 latency for service search rose from 141 ms to 362 ms (+157%), with a change point at 2026-03-06T07:35:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service search: 3 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.01).
At the same time, request volume for service search stayed about the same (2428 per 5 min before, 2952 per 5 min after, +22%).
At the same time, error rate for service search rose (0.41% before, 0.63% after, +56%).
p95 latency above SLO on search (search; 15 min after the change; record R015; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
search: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (search, eu-west; 9 min after the change; record R014; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
search: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (search, ap-south; 16 min after the change; record R016; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
search: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (search, us-east; 20 min after the change; record R017; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
search: INFO cache warmed in 1.8s (search, us-east; 292 min before the change; record R012; fit: describes a symptom, not a change)

reasons: ✗ No deploy, config change, ticket or alert lines up with the change.
✓ 4 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✗ A traffic cause is claimed, but request volume did not rise.
missing_data: Deploy and config-change history for the affected segment

actions.action: Implement a connection pool optimization to handle increased request volume.
Monitor request volume and adjust the connection pool size accordingly.
Run a campaign analysis to identify and mitigate any external factors affecting request volume.
